# Product: selecle

selecle ("select & execute") is a haunted, shared terminal workspace for the Kiroween hackathon's
Frankenstein track. Friends join one project over Telnet or WebSocket from any terminal. AI
**spirits** (headless agent runs) edit the project on their own git branches. **The Crypt** (a
common agent) reads the shared history and decides what to summon or banish.

- **Agent CLI:** Kiro CLI is the primary and default agent (ADR-026). Claude Code and Antigravity
  CLI are hidden alternates; do not surface them in user-facing text.
- **Voice:** spooky but plain. Messages say what happened and what to do next, in short sentences.
- **Safety first:** never `git init` a big or personal folder without asking; spirits get file
  tools only; guests start with chat only; secrets (API keys, tokens) are never read, stored or
  forwarded by selecle.
- **Honesty (ADR-021):** never present hand-written work as Kiro output. Say who wrote what.
